_comment: SHADOW MANIFEST — deliberately NOT under desks/.
file anywhere under desks/ would make sync_desk_config() write a Singapore
desk and source into the tracked production database on the next migration
run, which would put a non-collecting desk into public counts. It lives
here so production discovery cannot see it by accident, and a test asserts
Nothing in this file is read by pipeline.py. Only the shadow runner reads
it, and the shadow runner writes only to the shadow state branch.

institutions.notes: MINDEF publishes for itself and for the Singapore Armed Forces.

sources.notes: Tier A as the ministry's own authorized public position. Enabled is false and stays false: this source is under shadow evaluation and has never been part of a production run. Scope is documented in shadow/singapore_mindef/README.md.
